description: Lignes routières du réseau BreizhGo is a dataset listed in data.bretagne.bzh open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Bretagne. Lignes routières du réseau BreizhGo gérées par la région Bretagne. Ce réseau fusionne les anciens réseaux départementaux et l'ancien réseau régional. Coverage: Brittany. The portal files it under Transport - Mobilité. Its keywords are réseau BreizhGo, données ouvertes, car, 233500016, Bretagne. The portal shows 104 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ouverte : https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bretagne-bzh-portal.
